subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned Barnacle issue remain open as the public 20-PR-limit notice now that CONTRIBUTING.md and automation already implement the policy?
rationale: The code/docs state is already aligned, but the issue was reopened and pinned by maintainer action and carries product-review labels, so automation should not decide the communication policy.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the canonical short-form contributor-facing announcement while maintaining CONTRIBUTING.md and automation in sync.

options.title: Close As Docs-Owned
options.body: Unpin and close this issue only if maintainers want the contribution guide and automation comments to be the sole public policy surface.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer Discussion
options.body: Move the policy rationale into a maintainer-authored discussion or docs page, then close this bot-authored notice after the replacement is linked.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the canonical short-form contributor-facing announcement while maintaining CONTRIBUTING.md and automation in sync.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the live rename, reopen, and pin actions for this policy issue and has related workflow history.
